contents_tesim: The text of this section of the palimpsest presents many differences from the Assemani edition; references to the Assemani edition do not always have a precise equivalent. The missing text between fols. 173v and 180r (Assemani 47 F 4-48 F 6) must have occupied the central bifolio of the quire
full_text_tesim: Sloping pointed majuscule | Contrast between thick and thin strokes; presence of serifs at the ends of thin strokes; the vertical strokes of 'rho', 'ypsilon', 'phi' end with a curve to the left; 'beta' is maximized and has round curves; the oblique strokes of kappa are detached from the vertical stroke; the central strokes of mu are merged into a curve; omega has rounded curves; angle of inclination ca. 118°

The UTOs of Ps. Marcarius/Symeon, Epistula magna (ff. 171, 172, 176, 177, 181, 182) and Ephraem Syrus, Sermo asceticus (ff. 173, 174, 175, 178, 179, 180) were copied by the same scribe and were part of the same original codex
The missing text between fols. 173v and 180r (corresponding to Assemani 1732, 47 F 4-48 F 6) must have occupied the central bifolio of the quire
The sequence of the original quaternion can be reconstructed as follows: I (178rv), II (174vr), III (173rv), IV (fol. lost), V (fol. lost), VI (180rv), VII (179vr), VIII (175rv)
